events.title: Boston Cafe Bikers 1 year anniversary
events.description:
It’s been 1 YEAR since Boston Cafe Bikers hosted our first ride and we’re running back that same ride from Park St. Station in Boston to Yafa Bakery in Somerville.
Come celebrate a year of city biking, making friends, exploring cafés and building the cycling culture we deserve in the Boston area.
Bring a friend that hasn’t been on the rides yet 🫡
